unit.why: A short anecdote, told by a holy rabbi, about R. Isaac Junger of Jędrzejów: a Rosh Hashana decree of mortal danger is averted by daily charity set aside as a pidyon on a great tzaddik's instruction.

stories.start_quote: פ״א אמר הה״ק ר״ב על ר׳ אייזק
stories.summary_en: A great tzaddik sends word to R. Isaac Junger, community head of Jędrzejów, that a Rosh Hashana decree of danger hangs over him and that he must set aside charity money as a hidden pidyon every morning for a year; he does so, and that year he is saved from mortal danger three times.

tags.why: Daily pidyon money is set aside to avert a heavenly decree.
